newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady as repo cut awaited.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady as repo cut awaited.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates finished at 23.125 percent on Tuesday, unchanged from Monday, after moving in a narrow range between 23.00 and 23.25.
Traders said expectations of a reverse repo rate cut could subside if the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) continues to play what they see as a waiting game with the market.
"It wouldn't surprise me if the repo cut doesn't come at all," said Laszlo Csete of Hanmwha Bank. "I can't understand why they haven't done it yet. I think they are playing a psychological game."

Dealers have been diverting funds to the NBH for one-week and one-month reverse repo deals for a week as rumours continued of the cut. This has kept O/N rates relatively high as the spot market was left short of funds.

Tuesday's tax payment deadline was unlikely to affect rates much, Csete said. "Companies no longer leave everything until the last minute. The significance of the deadline has been reduced over the last few months," he said.
